description: Formations (battle-sim.md §10). spacing: metres between neighbours in a rank; rankSpacing: metres between ranks; set either ranks (width follows the squad size) or width (ranks follow); turnRate: how fast the squad turns its front (degrees/s, agreed 2026-11-20); holdWeight: how much harder members of a squad holding its ground are to push than men on the move (agreed: standing gives way less; 3 is a placeholder). Spacings are placeholders, tuned on the M1 bench.
